name: Emoji presentation selectors, keycaps and ZWJ sequences in a tool description (benign metadata)
notes: The zero-FP half of #114. hidden-chars-in-metadata now runs over the whole default-ignorable set, so the ordinary emoji plumbing must be carved out: a single VS16 after a pictograph (sparkles, copyright, trademark, heart), a keycap (digit + VS16 + U+20E3), a ZWJ chain containing a VS16 (heart on fire), and an RGI subdivision flag. Each carve-out validates its neighbours; a run or a selector after an ASCII letter is not carved out.
